successCriteria.description: The audit module at src/modules/audit/ exposes, via its public index.ts, an AuditLog model with exactly the canonical fields (id, actorId, action, entityType, entityId, beforeState, afterState, occurredAt), an IAuditRepository + PgAuditLogRepository, and an IAuditService + AuditService.

The notification module at src/modules/notification/ exposes, via its public index.ts, a Notification model with exactly the canonical fields (id, recipientId, type, title, message, relatedEntityType, relatedEntityId, status, createdAt, readAt), an INotificationRepository + PgNotificationRepository, and an INotificationService + NotificationService.

AuditLog.action is typed as the AuditAction enum and Notification.status is typed as the NotificationStatus enum, both imported from src/shared/types/index.ts (Notification.type remains a plain string).

Each repository's create operation persists a row (snake_case columns per the reconciled schema) and returns the mapped entity with a generated id; mapRow casts enum fields and converts snake_case to camelCase.
Each service rejects invalid input with ValidationError and unknown-id lookups with NotFoundError, matching the existing EmployeeService/LeaveTypeService/PolicyService semantics.

Notification creation is a synchronous direct insert: the repository/service method accepts an optional trailing PoolClient and performs no BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, so it can join the caller's transaction boundary (no BullMQ).

Jest unit tests exist at tests/unit/modules/audit-log.service.test.ts and tests/unit/modules/notification.service.test.ts using in-memory fake repositories implementing the interfaces, and the build gate (npm run build = tsc --noEmit, strict) passes.

constraints: Use the EXACT canonical entity field shapes from .gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json — do not rename, split, add, or omit fields on AuditLog or Notification.
Repositories must use the pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts (constructor default) and error types from src/shared/errors/index.ts; no direct db access outside the repository layer.

Follow the established module file convention: <name>.model.ts, <name>.repository.interface.ts, <name>.repository.ts, <name>.service.interface.ts, <name>.service.ts, and index.ts re-exporting all five.
Notifications are synchronous direct inserts within the caller's transaction boundary — no BullMQ, no queue, no background job.
Honor no-any (use unknown + type guards), no-direct-db-outside-repository, no-hardcoded-secrets, and no-gestalt-internal-deps; strict TypeScript with tsc --noEmit must pass.
Modules must not import from each other's internals — only from public index.ts (and shared foundations).
outOfScope: Consuming audit/notification side effects from the leave module (Phase 6 orchestration) — this phase only builds the write mechanism.
BullMQ / background job fanout for notifications — notifications are synchronous direct inserts only.
HTTP routes/controllers for audit or notification — these are service/repository modules with no REST surface in this phase.
Knex migrations / DDL for audit_logs and notifications tables — schema is specified in reconciled.json but migration generation is not part of this phase.
Reading/querying audit records for reporting (audit trail reports) — only the write path is in scope.

entityInvariants.invariant: An AuditLog is an immutable record of a single state-changing operation: once created it is never updated or deleted; its action must be one of the AuditAction enum values and its actorId must reference an existing employee.

A Notification is created with status PENDING and transitions through SENT → READ → ARCHIVED (per NotificationStatus); readAt is null until the notification is read, and recipientId must reference an existing employee.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Rejects invalid input (missing/empty actorId, entityType, entityId, or a non-AuditAction action) with ValidationError; returns the persisted AuditLog.
Throws NotFoundError when the id is unknown.
Rejects invalid input (missing/empty recipientId, type, title, message, or a non-NotificationStatus status) with ValidationError; returns the persisted Notification with status defaulting to PENDING.
Throws NotFoundError when the id is unknown.
Throws NotFoundError when the id is unknown; sets readAt and status READ.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Import AuditAction and NotificationStatus enums from src/shared/types/index.ts (do not redefine them locally); Notification.type is a plain string with no enum.
Use AppError subclasses (ValidationError 400, NotFoundError 404, ConflictError 409) from src/shared/errors/index.ts for all service error semantics.
Repositories use the pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts as the constructor default and accept an optional trailing PoolClient, matching the PgEmployeeRepository pattern.
Repository methods must map snake_case columns to the canonical camelCase entity fields and cast enum fields, matching the existing PgEmployeeRepository mapRow convention.
Service constructor injects the repository interface and validates via a private validate() throwing ValidationError, matching EmployeeService/LeaveTypeService/PolicyService.

Database columns, FKs, and indexes must match the reconciled schema: audit_logs(id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, before_state, after_state, occurred_at) with FK actor_id→employees.id; notifications(id, recipient_id, type, title, message, related_entity_type, related_entity_id, status, created_at, read_at) with FK recipient_id→employees.id.
Unit tests use in-memory fake repositories implementing the interfaces and assert typed error semantics, matching tests/unit/modules/employee.service.test.ts style.

integrationPoints.why: AuditAction and NotificationStatus enums are the canonical persisted values for AuditLog.action and Notification.status.
ValidationError/NotFoundError/ConflictError are the typed error contract every service must throw.
The shared pool is the default data-access connection for both repositories.
Phase 6 will wrap audit + notification inserts in IUnitOfWork.withTransaction; these repositories must accept the optional PoolClient to join that boundary.
